facts: Parties: Ivybridge Retail Group plc (Buyer), Rothley Engineering Ltd (Seller); the Company is Foxley Software Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 1 May 2026; Closing is scheduled for 25 June 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 1 May 2026), either party may terminate.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 28 October 2026.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Juniper Pharma plc threatening proceedings for approximately $3,400,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
